performance.verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google burns $507 with zero conversions for 28 days.

findings.text: Google Ads: $507.22 spent over 28 days, 0 conversions, 112 clicks — confirmed pixel/tracking failure or fundamentally wrong campaign type.
5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest: July 20) — GHL build gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified as of Sep 11.
GBP: 83 impressions over 21 days, 0 calls, 0 web clicks; gbp_7d_pct = -100% — profile is visible but generating zero response actions.
3-day Meta lead signal (Sep 8–10: 10+12+6=28 leads) vs prior 3 (Sep 5–7: 0+0+6=6) — strong 3-day recovery, but weekend zeros compress the prior window; trend is positive inside a stable 90-day shape.
GHL shows 130 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — 138 Meta leads arriving but no pipeline progression signals an intake or follow-up leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; pause spend if no fix confirmed within 5 days — $507 wasted with 0 conversions.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.22 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions and 112 clicks — this is either a broken pixel or a non-converting campaign type. The immediate action is to audit the conversion action setup in Google Ads and confirm the tag fires on the thank-you/confirmation page. If tracking is confirmed broken and not fixable within 5 days, pause Google spend and reallocate to Meta where CPL is $15.83 on 138 confirmed leads. Success check: at least 1 verified conversion recorded in Google Ads by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 130 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm intake automation and follow-up sequences are firing.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 130 opportunities created against 138 Meta leads in 28 days, but 0 appointments booked and 0 deals won — this points to a follow-up automation failure or an intake leak, not an ads problem. Action: Nacer to run a test lead through the full GHL flow and confirm the follow-up sequence triggers and an appointment slot is offered. Also cross-check whether Becklar deactivation and BWS duplicate paths (overdue SOW milestones) are silently blocking progression. Success check: at least 1 test lead reaches appointment stage with no manual intervention by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over the next 3 days; if it holds at or below $15.83, prepare a +15% budget case for next cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta's 3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10: 28 leads) is the strongest window in the series, and CPL sits at $15.83 on 138 leads over 28 days. No scale action is taken this cycle because the Google tracking failure (F1) and pipeline leak (F5) must be resolved first — scaling spend into a broken intake system wastes the gain. Re-check on 2026-09-14: if CPL remains at or below $15.83 and pipeline is confirmed functioning, bring a +15% Meta daily budget recommendation to Sohib.
